Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-system-property-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-system-property-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
ce-mark CE Marking StatusIndicates whether the AI system or relevant regulated product is documented as bearing a CE marking.
notified-body-id Notified Body IdentifierIdentifies the notified body involved in the applicable conformity-assessment procedure, where relevant.
expected-lifetime Expected LifetimeIdentifies the expected operational lifetime of the AI system or software component.
intended-purpose Intended PurposeIdentifies the purpose for which the AI system is intended to be used according to the provider's documentation.
target-population Target PopulationIdentifies the population for which the AI system is intended or validated to be used.
